defective_return_pct_defective_pct.name: defective_return_pct_defective_pct
defective_return_pct_defective_pct.description: Share of defective returns among classified returns, and the count of classified returns. This part: defective_pct = ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN STORE_RETURNS.SR_RETURN_REASON = 'defective' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN STORE_RETURNS.SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective', 'changed_mind') THEN 1 END), 0), 1).

definition.formula: ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN m.SR_RETURN_REASON = 'defective' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN m.SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective', 'changed_mind') THEN 1 END), 0), 1)

examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON='defective' THEN 1 END)*100.0/ NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective','changed_mind') THEN 1 END),0),1) AS defective_pct FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_RETURNS WHERE SR_RETURNED_DATE >= '2026-04-01' AND SR_RETURNED_DATE < '2026-07-01'

definition.grain: aggregate over entire filtered date range
definition.population: Store returns with a reason of 'defective' or 'changed_mind'
exclusions: returns with other reasons are excluded from the denominator

defective_return_pct_classified_returns.name: defective_return_pct_classified_returns
defective_return_pct_classified_returns.description: Share of defective returns among classified returns, and the count of classified returns. This part: classified_returns = COUNT(CASE WHEN STORE_RETURNS.SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective', 'changed_mind') THEN 1 END).

definition.formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN m.SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective', 'changed_mind') THEN 1 END)
definition.grain: aggregate over entire filtered date range
definition.population: Store returns with a reason of 'defective' or 'changed_mind'
exclusions: returns with other reasons are excluded from the denominator
